commands.label: claude-cli-gpg-vault
commands.note: Overwrite claude_cli_setup.sh with GPG vault for API key. Update README.txt to document GPG step. Unix LF throughout.
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "New-Item -Force -ItemType Directory -Path 'D:\claude_boot' | Out-Null; $sh = @('#!/bin/sh','# Alpine Linux - Claude CLI Setup with GPG API Key Vault','# Usage: sh /media/usb/claude_boot/claude_cli_setup.sh','','USB=/media/usb/claude_boot','KEYFILE=$USB/api.key.gpg','','# Install packages','apk add --no-cache gnupg nodejs npm git curl','','# Install Claude CLI','npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code','','# GPG vault: encrypt API key on first run, decrypt on subsequent runs','if [ ! -f "$KEYFILE" ]; then','  echo ""','  echo "First run: enter your Anthropic API key (sk-ant-...) then press Enter:"','  read -r APIKEY','  echo -n "$APIKEY" | gpg --batch --yes --symmetric --cipher-algo AES256 --passphrase-fd 0 -o "$KEYFILE" <<EOF','  EOF','  # Simpler interactive version:','  echo -n "$APIKEY" > /tmp/_k','  gpg --symmetric --cipher-algo AES256 -o "$KEYFILE" /tmp/_k','  rm -f /tmp/_k','  echo "API key saved to $KEYFILE (GPG encrypted)"','fi','','# Decrypt to env var','export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=$(gpg -d "$KEYFILE" 2>/dev/null)','if [ -z "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" ]; then','  echo "GPG decrypt failed. Delete $KEYFILE and re-run to re-encrypt."','  exit 1','fi','','echo "API key loaded. Starting Claude CLI..."','claude'); $text = $sh -join "`n"; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText('D:\claude_boot\claude_cli_setup.sh', $text + "`n", [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8); Write-Output 'SETUP_SH_GPG_OK'; $rm = @('ALPINE LINUX CLAUDE CLI - COMPLETE SETUP GUIDE','==============================================','Built: 2026-10-28 | Drive: D:\ (Ventoy USB)','','FILES ON THIS DRIVE','-------------------','  alpine-standard-3.24.3-x86_64.iso  <- Ventoy boots this','  localhost.apkovl.tar.gz            <- auto-login overlay','  ventoy\ventoy.json                 <- 5s autoboot config','  claude_boot\claude_cli_setup.sh    <- PRIMARY: run after boot','  claude_boot\api.key.gpg            <- API key (GPG AES256, created on 1st run)','  claude_boot\README.txt             <- this file','','BOOT (STEP 1)','-------------','  F12 -> Ventoy USB -> Alpine (auto in 5s) -> root login (automatic)','','SETUP-ALPINE (STEP 2 - first time only)','---------------------------------------','  setup-alpine','    hostname: [enter]   interface: eth0/wlan0   ip: dhcp','    disk: none          lbu media: usb','','MOUNT USB (STEP 3)','------------------','  mkdir -p /media/usb','  mount /dev/sdb1 /media/usb  (try sdc1 if sdb is internal disk)','','RUN SETUP SCRIPT (STEP 4)','-------------------------','  sh /media/usb/claude_boot/claude_cli_setup.sh','','  FIRST RUN: prompts for API key -> encrypts to api.key.gpg (AES256)','  NEXT RUNS: decrypts automatically, launches claude','','  API KEY source: https://console.anthropic.com -> API Keys','','SAVE TO USB (STEP 5 - for fast next boot)','------------------------------------------','  umount /media/usb && lbu commit','  (saves installed packages + /etc to USB overlay)','','NOTES','-----','  - api.key.gpg = AES256 symmetric GPG. Passphrase set interactively.','  - Never store raw API key as plain text on USB','  - Go setup also available: sh /media/usb/claude_boot/alpine_go_setup.sh'); $rt = $rm -join "`n"; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText('D:\claude_boot\README.txt', $rt + "`n", [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8); Write-Output 'README_GPG_OK'"
